clips.title: The story
paras: Alterac was one of the seven historic human kingdoms, nestled high in the rugged Alterac Mountains. During the Second War, its ruler, King Aiden Perenolde, made a treacherous pact with the Old Horde to spare his realm, leading to the kingdom's military downfall and total collapse. Today, its ruined capital lies abandoned in the snow, while dispossessed nobles and outlaws wage a guerrilla war under the banner of the Syndicate.

Alterac arose thousands of years ago as an Arathorian city-state following the Troll Wars. Settlers capitalized on strategic mountain passes and trading outposts, eventually establishing an independent realm when the empire fractured. Though rugged and mountainous, Alterac bordered the prosperous lands of Lordaeron and Stromgarde. Historically, it fielded tough mountain fighters, but enduring border friction with Thoras Trollbane's Stromgarde left the kingdom politically isolated from its neighbors long before the Dark Portal ever opened.
